description: Defines a singleton class 'MessageCommandMappingStrategies' that maintains a mapping from signal types to JsonifiableMapper instances for message commands, facilitating conversions between signal commands and JSON representations in an Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context.

classes.name: MessageCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that holds mapping strategies from message command signal types to JsonifiableMapper instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the map associating message command types with their respective mapping functions.

methods.name: featureIdForMessageFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the payload within the adaptable object, throwing a JsonParseException if not present.
